description_en: You can invoke ListRecentCallDetailRecords to obtain the list of recent call detail records for agents mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user under the specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListRecentCallDetailRecords获取指定实例下当前RAM账号映射的坐席的最近通话记录列表
name: ListRecentCallDetailRecords

parameters.description_en: Page ordinal number, ranging from 1 to 100.
parameters.help_en: Page ordinal number, ranging from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: Start UNIX timestamp. The default value is the start time of the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time.
parameters.description_zh: 开始时间戳，默认是当天开始时间，最早为当前时间往前180天。
parameters.help_en: Start UNIX timestamp. The default value is the start time of the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳，默认是当天开始时间，最早为当前时间往前180天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: End UNIX timestamp. The default value is the current time.
parameters.description_zh: 截止时间戳，默认是当前时间。
parameters.help_en: End UNIX timestamp. The default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间戳，默认是当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en: Fuzzy search criteria in JSON object format. The object contains three properties that can be combined arbitrarily: phoneNumber (fuzzy search by calling or called number), callingNumber (fuzzy search by calling number), and calledNumber (fuzzy search by called number).
parameters.description_zh: 模糊搜索条件，格式为JSON对象，对象包含三个属性，可以随机组合，三个属性分别为phoneNumber（按主叫或被叫号码模糊搜索）、callingNumber（按主叫号码模糊搜索）和calledNumber（按被叫号码模糊搜索）。
